length.source: Gerdes AM, Kellerman SE, Moore JA, et al. Structural remodeling of cardiac myocytes in patients with ischemic cardiomyopathy. Circulation 1992;86(2):426-30. doi:10.1161/01.cir.86.2.426, PubMed 1638711 (abstract)
length.note: mean myocyte length, left-ventricular myocytes isolated from 3 nonfailing donor hearts (normal coronary arteries); ± 9 µm as reported; quote found in the PubMed record: “197 +/- 8 versus 141 +/- 9 microns”

length_width_ratio.source: Gerdes AM, Kellerman SE, Moore JA, et al. Structural remodeling of cardiac myocytes in patients with ischemic cardiomyopathy. Circulation 1992;86(2):426-30. doi:10.1161/01.cir.86.2.426, PubMed 1638711 (abstract)
length_width_ratio.note: cell length/width ratio, nonfailing donor hearts, ± 0.6; quote found in the PubMed record: “11.2 +/- 0.9 versus 7.5 +/- 0.6”

width.note: formula: width = length / (length/width ratio); inputs: cardiomyocyte.length, cardiomyocyte.length_width_ratio; ratio of the two reported means; the paper's own mean width is not in the abstract

thickness.source: Manandhar S, Wu Y, Pathak T, et al. Differential cardiac remodelling: patterns of cardiomyocyte morphometry in multiple patient conditions. Cardiovasc Res 2026;122(14):1964-1977. doi:10.1093/cvr/cvag166, PubMed 42530239, PMC13653500 (Results; CC BY-NC 4.0)
thickness.note: myocyte maximum inscribed circle diameter of transverse profiles, H&E sections of mid left-ventricular free wall, 202 non-failing donor hearts, ± 2.7 µm; used here as the cell's thickness (the smaller transverse dimension), fixed tissue; quote found in https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC13653500/fullTextXML: “MMIC diameter of 15.70 ± 2.7 μm”

sarcomere_length.source: Ohler A, Weisser-Thomas J, Piacentino V, et al. sarcomere_length.note: mean resting sarcomere length from transmitted-light images, ventricular myocytes from non-failing human hearts (11 cells, 2 hearts), ± 0.011 µm SEM; quote found in https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC2833295/fullTextXML: “1.899 ± 0.011 μ m versus 1.917”

sarcomeres_along_length.note: formula: length / sarcomere length; inputs: cardiomyocyte.length, cardiomyocyte.sarcomere_length
